title: Bounded above objects with shift-relatively-pseudo-coherent cohomology are relatively pseudo-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For X -> S locally of finite type, m in Z and E in D(O_X) which is locally bounded above with each cohomology sheaf H^i(E) (m - i)-pseudo-coherent relative to S, the object E is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S. The retained proof is written: follow from Cohomology, lemma cohomology-pseudo-coherent (the absolute statement that bounded-above objects with shifted-pseudo-coherent cohomology are pseudo-coherent) and the definitions — via the chart definition the relative statement is the absolute one on the derived category of the chart complexes, so the absolute lemma applies verbatim. This is the cohomological upgrade of this wave's termwise card L16191. Retained author proof at lines 17105-17109.
